description: Control whether contacts are automatically detected during simulation. Contact detection is enabled (on) by default. When enabled, the system automatically creates new contacts when pieces come together and deletes contacts when pieces separate beyond detection criteria. When disabled (off), no new contacts are created and no existing contacts are deleted, regardless of piece motion. Detection can be controlled globally for all contact types or selectively by contact type (ball-ball, ball-facet, etc.). This is a fundamental control for managing contact lifecycle in PFC simulations.

python_sdk_alternative.workaround: itasca.command('contact detection <on/off>') - Python SDK does not provide direct contact detection control API. Must use command interface.
notes: Detection state is a global simulation setting, not a per-contact property, so Python SDK does not expose this functionality.
Contact detection is ON by default - automatic contact management
Detection OFF: no new contacts created, no existing contacts deleted
Detection occurs during cycling based on piece motion and tolerance extents
Can control globally (all types) or selectively (specific types)
Disabling detection does NOT delete existing contacts
Use 'model clean' to force immediate contact detection when detection is on
Detection state persists until explicitly changed
Type-specific control allows fine-grained contact management
Common temporary disable: contact detection off → manipulate → contact detection on
Related commands: contact delete, contact persist, contact cmat proximity, model clean, contact create
model clean has no effect while detection is off.
Detection can be toggled independently per contact type (ball-ball, ball-facet, ball-pebble, pebble-pebble, pebble-facet, ball-rblock, pebble-rblock, rblock-facet, rblock-rblock); all start on.

keywords.syntax: type {ball-ball | ball-facet | ball-pebble | ball-rblock | pebble-facet | pebble-pebble | pebble-rblock | rblock-facet | rblock-rblock} ...
keywords.description: Turn off contact detection for a specific type of contact. All other contacts will be detected. Options: ball-ball: Specify the contact detection state for ball-ball contacts.; ball-facet: Specify the contact detection state for ball-facet contacts.; ball-pebble: Specify the contact detection state for ball-pebble contacts.; ball-rblock: Specify the contact detection state for ball-rblock contacts.; pebble-facet: Specify the contact detection state for pebble-facet contacts.; pebble-pebble: Specify the contact detection state for pebble-pebble contacts.; pebble-rblock: Specify the contact detection state for pebble-rblock contacts.; rblock-facet: Specify the contact detection state for rblock-facet contacts.; rblock-rblock: Specify the contact detection state for rblock-rblock contacts.
